English: Ember Patch
A small, sacred patch of ground marked with stones and smoldering embers, tended by the faithful to honor the fire spirits. Serves as a focal point for clan gatherings and ritual unity.
Torch Stand
A set of sturdy wooden poles supporting torches, illuminating the night and drawing the clan together for worship and council.
Flame Pavilion
A large, canvas-draped tent built around a central fire, where priests chant and lead the clan in communal rites and festivals.
Fire Room
A semi-permanent wooden structure with a central hearth, enclosed to keep the sacred flame burning through the harshest weather, and a gathering place for clan elders.
Priests Hut
A dedicated hut for the resident fire priest, filled with ritual implements and offerings, serving as a hub for spiritual leadership.
Sanctified Chamber
A reinforced, sanctified space built from stone and timber, where sacred relics are kept and rituals of purification are held for the clan.
Holy Fire Hall
A spacious, decorated hall of wood and stone, serving as the heart of religious life for the clan, where the sacred fire is never allowed to die.
Blessed Pavilion
A grand tent complex adorned with ritual banners and sacred symbols, where major festivals and clan councils are presided over by the high priest.
Fire Sanctuary
A fortified sanctuary of faith, its eternal flame visible for miles, drawing pilgrims and uniting the clans in reverence and awe.
Pagan Fire Shrine
A majestic shrine of stone and gold, ringed by ever-burning pyres, the supreme symbol of clan unity, faith, and the sacred fires eternal guidance.
